title: Source-defined CMIX deep midpoint ceiling oracle
hypothesis: A deterministic 32-event truncated-BPTT update after causally decoded first halves produces target-scale arithmetic savings that exceed a matched causal-misalignment control on the qualified memory-safe CMIX parent.
promotion_condition: At 10MB, F saves at least 40,793 arithmetic archive bytes over P, beats S globally and in every preregistered third, repeats byte-identically, decodes exactly, reconstructs canonical input exactly, and passes resource receipts.
kill_condition: Retire the CMIX midpoint family if the 1MB F oracle is below 4,080 gross archive bytes, if F does not beat S, or if exact P/K synchronization cannot be achieved by one correction-only implementation successor.
claim_boundary: Oracle-only proposal with zero score credit; activation requires a qualified memory-safe CMIX parent and an absent exclusive full-1G lease.
